name: Brad's Summer
source:
Take on the role of Brad, a slacker who lost his college scholarship because he partied too much. Realizing that if he wants to continue his education, he has to get a job to pay for tuition, room and board. There's a job opening at a nearby school for girls. Will Brad get the job? Can he follow the "no fraternizing" rule? Which of the young ladies will win his heart?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=30&t=9436]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
玩家将扮演布拉德——一个因过度沉迷派对而失去大学奖学金的懒汉。他意识到，要想继续学业，就必须找份工作来支付学费和食宿费。附近一所女子学校恰好正在招聘。布拉德能拿到这份工作吗？他能遵守“不得与学生交往”的规定吗？哪位年轻姑娘会最终赢得他的心？
